questions.stem: During the electrolysis of copper sulfate solution with carbon electrodes, what forms at the cathode?
questions.explanation: Copper is less reactive than hydrogen, so copper ions (Cu²⁺) are preferentially discharged at the cathode instead of hydrogen ions. The half-equation is Cu²⁺ + 2e⁻ → Cu. A pink/brown coating of copper metal deposits on the cathode.
